0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets (7-1, 1st in the Southwest and 1st in the West) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-4, 12th in the West), with Houston on a two-game winning streak and Phoenix on a three-game losing streak. Houston will be without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 4-0 and beat Phoenix 119-105 in Phoenix in their most recent meeting on April 7.
